lessons_used: Reordering sign-in after adoption consistently degraded performance across 2 tests and led to early stops.

Home wait-time info (4 wins across 8 tests), adoption redesigns (2 wins across 5 tests), and finish redesigns (2 wins across 7 tests) yielded clear wins, though several tests in these categories showed no clear effect.

Choose-path layout (4 tests), choose-path copy (3 tests), sign-in hints (4 tests), sign-in notifications (4 tests), and sign-in copy (2 tests) consistently showed no clear effect or degraded performance.
Categories with only a single test (such as adoption incentives, adoption notifications, or finish notifications) still provide evidence that is thin.
Predictions consistently underestimated major winning tests while overestimating changes that showed no clear effect or degraded performance.
